text:
Margo Li: Heads-up kickoff for cloud listing activation flow. Main gaps: marketplace fee metadata, entitlement mapping for trials, and support contact format per cloud.

Devon Hart: I can take fee metadata and billing SKU alignment. Do we publish net price or gross price in AWS listing?

Samir Khan: AWS wants list price + billing metering detail. GCP prefers a single recurring price with billing terms in the offer description. Azure needs both price and an itemized fee sheet for their marketplace review.

Margo Li: ok, action: Devon = price table for each cloud. Samir = support contact format + entitlement mapping.

Devon Hart: rough CSV I'll use for mapping: `sku,cloud,price_usd,trial_days,concurrency_limit`

Samir Khan: support contact needs: `name`, `email`, `timezone`, and `sla_link`. Also note that AWS requires a support phone number for some enterprise listings.

AzureOpsBot: Reminder: publisher slot validation incomplete. Missing `offer_visibility` field in asset manifest. See https://partners.azure.example/manifest-guide

Margo Li: Samir can you add `offer_visibility` (Public/Private) to the manifest and mark which clouds will be private offers for pilots?

Samir Khan: added to draft. Pilots: AWS private (partner offer), others public. Will post manifest excerpt.

Samir Khan: ```json
{"product":"redwood-inference","offer_visibility":"Private","support":{"name":"Samir Khan","email":"support@redwood.ai","phone":"+1-415-555-0133"},"trial":{"sku":"rwd-trial-14d","days":14}}
```

LegalBot: Note: If offer is Private on AWS but Public elsewhere, listings must not imply identical data residency guarantees. Add explicit clause in description.

Devon Hart: uploading pricing CSV to gs://marketplace-staging/2940012345/pricing.csv and attaching to the manifest.

Margo Li: timeline: goal to submit to clouds by EOD Friday. Next steps: Devon finalize prices (tomorrow AM), Samir finalize manifest & support card (tomorrow AM), Legal review marketing copy (tomorrow PM).

Samir Khan: will also schedule a 15-min sync with Azure ops to confirm publisher requirements.

Margo Li: perfect, dropping a quick checklist in Confluence and will tag owners. :white_check_mark:
